column1: # Push and merge spellings and what ship-gate must do with each, run through the one shared parser.
# expect: gate = judged against evidence (denied unreviewed, passed with a bundle, scanned by git-guard);
#         pass = never a gated action (a tag, a deletion, a dry run, or not a push at all);
#         deny = cannot be attributed to one repo and branch, so refused with the user-run command.
# Placeholders: {repo} = the clone, {tmp} = a directory outside any repo, {head} = the feature commit;
# a literal \n in the command is a newline. The fixture repo is on branch `feature` and holds tag `tmp`
# clone (optional): gated (default) = a clone of the gated acme/app; fork = a clone of the ungated fork
# me/app whose `upstream` remote is acme/app and whose branch `feature` pushes to upstream; fork-origin =
# another clone of that fork whose branch `feature` pushes to origin.
